name: taskrail
description: Inspect and manage local computer automations through a typed, approval-aware MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Taskrail connects a user-owned Mac or Linux automation daemon to an MCP host. It discovers native jobs, reports runs and logs, summarizes typed integrations, and keeps local writes behind explicit policy and approvals.
defaultPrompt: Show the local automations and what needs attention.
Discover the native scheduler jobs on this host.
Explain the latest failed automation run.
